deployments_detail.use: Parent takes "wait-and-see" AI stance; subsidiary GEICO deploying AI in marketing + telematics (characterized as catch-up vs Progressive)

GEICO uses Tractable's AI Review computer-vision system to assess vehicle damage from claim photos, identifying damage and evaluating repair estimates in seconds versus ~30-minute manual reviews, flagging exceptions for human adjusters. [Tractable]
deployments_detail.value: estimates assessed within seconds vs ~30-minute manual review

deployments_detail.use: GEICO used an AI-driven system in its auto-insurance policy underwriting/cancellation review process; after a Pennsylvania Attorney General probe found it caused an improper cancellation, GEICO agreed to modify the process. Confirms the AI review was in production.

BNSF Railway operates ODIN (onboard laser/sensor track-geometry measurement) and THOR (high-speed optical cameras with machine-vision algorithms) for automated track inspection and defect detection at up to 70 mph, supporting predictive maintenance.
deployments_detail.value: THOR imaged 165,000 miles and found 1,900 defects in 2025; track-caused equipment incidents down 33%

deployments_detail.use: BNSF combined AI, algorithmic optimization and machine learning to automate rail-car switching decisions in classification yards, improving safety and efficiency of the switching process.
BNSF uses AI/machine-learning demand forecasting to predict shipment volumes and match capacity to customer demand ('just right' service) across its intermodal and container network.

McLane Company (Berkshire subsidiary) launched driverless commercial freight hauls with Aurora, running fully autonomous trucks between Dallas and Houston distribution terminals seven days a week, expanding across the Sun Belt. [Aurora Innovation]

BNSF deployed Predictive Vegetation Management (PVM) combining LiDAR scanning with machine learning, soil composition and historical weather data to forecast vegetation growth and optimize crew dispatch across its network.

McLane Company opened an AI/technology hub in Austin, Texas to develop AI and data capabilities for its foodservice and grocery supply-chain distribution business, appointing a Chief Information and Digital Officer.

Pilot Flying J (Pilot Company) deployed Infor Coleman AI for daily finance anomaly detection across hundreds of thousands of accounting line items, plus fuel-margin optimization, with workforce management and sales forecasting in development. [Infor Coleman AI]
deployments_detail.value: ~3 hours saved per accountant daily; projected $750,000/yr from penny-level fuel pricing precision

deployments_detail.use: GEICO deployed CCC Intelligent Solutions' Smart Red Flag Detection with Cross-Carrier Analysis, using deep learning to scan claims data and photos for suspicious patterns and compare claims across carriers to detect potential fraud. [CCC Intelligent Solutions]
GEICO opened a Palo Alto office dedicated to driving AI and technology innovation as part of its broader tech/infrastructure transformation.

GEICO brought its Gecko mascot into live, unscripted conversation for the first time using a real-time generative AI voice system for marketing/brand engagement (including an AI-generated podcast appearance).

Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices franchises (The Preferred/Stouffer Realty) launched 'AI BOSS' and an AI-powered home search tool to assist agents and buyers in property discovery and brokerage operations.
